The gluteus maximus is the largest muscle in the buttock region and is indeed one of the largest and most powerful muscles in the human body. It's the primary muscle responsible for hip extension and is the most prominent buttock muscle.

The gluteus medius is also a buttock muscle, but it's smaller than the gluteus maximus and located more on the side/upper portion of the buttock.

1. The largest of the gluteal muscles
2. The most prominent buttock muscle
3. Commonly referred to as THE large buttock muscle
